[RAZI-FULL:v2p62#2/r10] RAZI-FULL, d. 606 · author | reports | “We are only mocking” may emphasize their continued disbelief, replace “we are with you” because belittling Islam magnifies unbelief, or answer an imagined objection about why they appear to side with Muslims.
